taskDesc1111021.en:
Forge an artifact.


Forging Artifacts:
Kill <r>Dark Crystal Spirit</r> and <r>Darkfire Mask</r> to obtain books that increase your Ore and Forge stats.
Buy Forge Charts from <r>Workshops</r> in various Towns. Learn them to forge the corresponding artifacts via <r>artisanship</r>.
Forging an artifacts consumes a Core Material, as well as Supplementary Materials, Rare Materials, and the matching type of Samadhi Flame.
Kill <r>Mythical Beast Lords</r> in various areas to obtain Core Materials.
Kill normal monsters or challenge Fallen Valley to obtain Supplementary Materials. They can also be mined in various areas.
Rare Materials are obtained from the 6 special areas in Hua Feng, Land of the Beginning (Yun Mo), the 5 sealed creatures in Everfrost, the 6 Tao Realms in Mu Xian, etc.
Spend Sect Contribution to redeem Samadhi Flames at the <r>Treasure Pavilion</r> in your sect.
taskDesc1111021.ch:
炼制一次法宝。


法宝炼制之法：
击杀<r>玄晶石灵</r>与<r>黯炎邪面</r>可分别获得用于提升矿材资质与炼器资质的书籍。
在各区域城镇的<r>工坊</r>内，可以购买各个法宝的炼器谱，学习后便可通过<r>技艺</r>进行炼器。
炼器需要核心材料、辅助材料、稀有材料与炼器真火四种物品。
核心材料可以通过击杀各区域的<r>妖兽之王</r>获得。
辅助材料可以通过击杀普通怪物、挑战陨幽谷或在各大区域挖矿获得。
稀有材料可以通过华封州的六处特殊区域、云陌州的乾坤元境、永恒冰原的五处镇灵、暮仙州的六处道界等区域产出。
炼器真火可以通过宗门贡献在宗门<r>聚宝仙楼</r>中兑换得到。

taskDesc126002.en: Help {unitName} attack {troubleDesc}—Attack the person they want to attack to help them get rid of their troubles and complete the mission.
taskDesc126002.ch: 帮助{unitName}击杀{troubleDesc}——将其所欲击杀之人手刃便可助其消除烦恼，完成任务。

taskDesc131001.en:
In order to restore Dragon Mountain Hamlet, you must first raise the Prestige of the Sect to <r>{attrValue}</r>.
Completing Sect Missions or dispatching notable disciples to take care of External Affair missions will increase Sect Prestige.
taskDesc131001.ch:
为了重振御龙山庄，需要先将宗门的名誉提升至<r>{attrValue}</r>。
完成宗门任务或派遣记名弟子执行外务堂的任务即可提升宗门名誉。

taskDesc132001.en: Give {dieName}'s {targetPropsName} to {targetUnitName}. Based on {dieName}'s information, you may head to the Tavern in {townName} to make inquiries.
taskDesc132001.ch: 将{dieName}的{targetPropsName}交给{targetUnitName}。根据{dieName}的消息去{townName}的酒馆打听一下吧。

taskDesc2110001.en: Go to the location marked on the map and find the missing Young Master Ji.
taskDesc2110001.ch: 前往图中所记载的位置，寻找失踪的季家少主。

taskDesc2110002.en: Defeat the Swordmaster and rescue Young Master Ji.
taskDesc2110002.ch: 战胜神秘的剑修，救下季家少主。

taskDesc2110003.en: Escort Young Master Ji back to {mapData108}.

taskDesc2110004.en: Kill Tiangou who's wreaking havoc in {mapData108}.

taskDesc2110005.en: Kill Tiangou who's wreaking havoc in {mapData108}.

taskDesc2110006.en: Find {itemLink5081455} in order to obtain Jiaolong's legacy.
taskDesc2110006.ch: 为了获得司雨神龙的传承，寻找{itemLink5081455}。

taskDesc2110007.en: To help Xuangui reconstruct its body, you must deliver 3 pieces of the following Heaven and Earth Treasure to the Priest: {itemLink5081465}, {itemLink5081475}, {itemLink5081485}, {itemLink5081495}, {itemLink5081505}, {itemLink5081515}, {itemLink5081525}.
taskDesc2110007.ch: 为了帮助玄龟重塑肉身，从{itemLink5081465}、{itemLink5081475}、{itemLink5081485}、{itemLink5081495}、{itemLink5081505}、{itemLink5081515}、{itemLink5081525}等天材地宝中任取3个交给神官。

taskDesc2110008.en: Obtain a Soul Reconstruction Elixir and deliver it to Gouchen's Priest.
taskDesc2110008.ch: 寻找化神丹，将其交给勾陈的神官。

taskDesc2110009.en: Obtain {itemLink6121036} and deliver it to Chongming's Priest.
taskDesc2110009.ch: 将寻到的{itemLink6121036}交给重明的神官。

taskDesc2110010.en: Obtain {itemLink6121046} and deliver it to Luwu's Priest.
taskDesc2110010.ch: 将祭祀陆吾用的{itemLink6121046}交给神官。

taskDesc2110011.en:
Follow the Magic Wind Stone's guidance to retrieve the keepsake Chongming gave to its Priest.
Perform Geomancy near the target location to pinpoint the exact location.
taskDesc2110011.ch:
根据幻风石的引导，帮助神官寻回重明的信物。
在目标点附近使用堪舆，可以查探到信物所在的具体方位。

taskDesc2110012.ch: 在云陌州中，取得祭祀陆吾用的{itemLink6121046}。

taskDesc2110101.en: Talk to strange giant in Everfrost.
taskDesc2110101.ch: 与永恒冰原中的怪异巨人交谈。

taskDesc2110102.en: Agar seems to be in trouble. Find out what's going on.
taskDesc2110102.ch: 阿夸似乎遇到了麻烦，去看看怎么回事。

taskDesc2110103.en: Determine the source of the unbearable heat.
taskDesc2110103.ch: 探查荒土地中的情况，找出炎热的源头。

taskDesc2110104.en: Drive away the Drought Demon so that Agar can pass through.
taskDesc2110104.ch: 为了让阿夸通过此地，驱逐荒土地上的旱魃。

taskDesc2110105.en:
Get Darkwind Grass for the Drought Demon so that she'll leave this area.
Darkwind Grass is auctioned off in {#areaName8}.
The auction there happens every 2 years.
taskDesc2110105.ch:
为了让旱魃离开此地，帮助魃寻找乌风草。
据说乌风草会在{#areaName8}中的拍卖会上出现。
拍卖会每隔2年举办一次。

taskDesc2110106.en:
Agar is dying. Help him recover!
Give {itemLink6361026} to Agar so he can recover Vitality. Give {itemLink6361016} to Agar so he can recover Stamina and Health.
taskDesc2110106.ch:
阿夸就快不行了，赶紧前去帮助他恢复状态吧。
给予夸父{itemLink6361026}可帮助夸父回复体力；给予夸父{itemLink6361016}可帮助夸父回复精力与健康。

taskDesc2110107.en: Find the fruit that helps Agar recover his status.
taskDesc2110107.ch: 给阿夸寻找能够恢复状态的果子。

taskDesc2110108.en: Find the spring water that helps Agar recover his status.
taskDesc2110108.ch: 给阿夸寻找能够恢复状态的泉水。

taskDesc2110109.en:
To improve the condition of the Wei River, you need to get the Water Dragon Tripod from Jimeng.
Perform Geomancy near the target location to pinpoint the exact location of Jimeng's cave.
taskDesc2110109.ch:
为了让渭水变得宜居，寻找计蒙求取神器。
在目标点附近使用堪舆，可寻到计蒙洞府的准确地点。

taskDesc2110110.en: Defeat Jimeng and obtain the Water Dragon Tripod.
taskDesc2110110.ch: 为了帮助鲮鱼祈雨，打败计蒙并抢夺溟霖鼎。

taskDesc2110111.en:
Get Jimeng what he wants so that he'll lend you the Water Dragon Tripod.
Collect any 3 pieces of <r>Jadeware</r> for Jimeng.
taskDesc2110111.ch:
为了借到溟霖鼎，帮助计蒙收集他喜欢的东西。
将任意3个<r>玉器</r>交给计蒙。

taskDesc2110112.en: Return to the Wei River, then use the Water Dragon Tripod to summon rain.
taskDesc2110112.ch: 回到渭水边上，使用溟霖鼎为暮仙州祈雨。

taskDesc2110113.en: Agar is having an argument with a river creature. Mediate between those two.
taskDesc2110113.ch: 阿夸与渭水生灵起了争执，去帮忙解决吧。

taskDesc2110114.en: Agar has chased the sun to the edge of Nether Mountains. Find him.
taskDesc2110114.ch: 阿夸追逐太阳来到了冥山边上，快去找到他。

taskDesc2110115.en: Drive away Carpia from this area, allowing Agar to drink as much water as he wants.
taskDesc2110115.ch: 把找事的鲮鱼赶出此地，让阿夸喝个够。

taskDesc2110116.en: Everything is ALMOST ready. The last step—charging into Nether Mountains!
taskDesc2110116.ch: 万事俱备，剩下的就是不顾一切冲进冥山了。

taskDesc2110117.en: Sunny tells you the method to break through Nether Mountains. It's risky but worth a try.
taskDesc2110117.ch: 圣阳诉说了传闻中可能破开冥山的方法，只好冒险一试了。

taskDesc2110118.en: Agar has fallen. Turns out the sun he's been chasing is Sunny. Talk to her.
taskDesc2110118.ch: 阿夸倒下了，原来他追逐的太阳就是圣阳，上前与她交谈一番吧。

taskDesc2110119.en: Agar has fallen. Turns out the sun he's been chasing is Sunny. Talk to her.
taskDesc2110119.ch: 阿夸倒下了，原来他追逐的太阳就是圣阳，上前与她交谈一番吧。

taskDesc2110201.en: Go back to Yukong Village and attend the Foolish Old Man's sky burial.
taskDesc2110201.ch: 回到愚村参加愚公的天葬之礼。

taskDesc2110202.en: Go in the direction indicated by the Iron Shard and reach the cave where Jagu used to live.
taskDesc2110202.ch: 跟随铁尺的指向，到达武罗当年居住的山洞。

taskDesc2110203.en: Find some suitable {itemLink6131026} and wash the dirt from the cave wall.
taskDesc2110203.ch: 寻找合适的{itemLink6131026}来洗刷洞穴墙壁的污垢。

taskDesc2110204.en: Return to the cave and continue inspecting the paintings on the cave wall.
taskDesc2110204.ch: 回到洞穴中继续查看壁画。

taskDesc2110205.en: Perform geomancy at target locations along the Iron Shard's trajectory and locate the buried object.
taskDesc2110205.ch: 沿着铁尺的轨迹在目标地点堪舆，找到被埋藏的东西。

taskDesc2110207.en: Return to the Bamboo Slat and unseal it.

taskDesc2110301.en: Return to Duality Village and defeat the Blood Lord ensconced there.
taskDesc2110301.ch: 回到两仪村，击败盘踞其中的血魔。

taskDesc2110302.en: Go in the direction indicated by the Iron Shard and reach the outskirts of Duality Village.
taskDesc2110302.ch: 跟随铁尺的指向，到达双仪村的周围。

taskDesc2110303.en: Collect one {itemLink1011722}, {itemLink1011723} or {itemLink1011724}, and rescue Xi. Elixirs can be made using Elixir Recipes sold at City Workshops in certain regions.
taskDesc2110303.ch: 收集一枚{itemLink1011722}，{itemLink1011723}或{itemLink1011724}，救活阿嬉。丹药可以通过在部分区域的主城工坊内购置丹方炼制而成。

taskDesc2110304.en: Collect {itemLink5031966}, return to Xi and break the seal on Bi Fang's tail feather.
taskDesc2110304.ch: 收集{itemLink5031966}并回到阿嬉身边，解开毕方尾羽的禁制。

taskDesc2110305.ch: 击败偷袭而来的剑修刺客。

taskDesc2110401.en: Go to the main city in Yun Mo and meet Xi.
taskDesc2110401.ch: 去到云陌州主城与阿嬉相见。

taskDesc2110402.en: Collect an Elixir to enable Xi to enter Everfrost- 1 G3 {itemLink1011606} or above. Once you have it, go and find Xi on the edge of Everfrost.
taskDesc2110402.ch: 收集能让阿嬉进入永恒冰原的丹药——三品及以上的{itemLink1011606}一枚，收集完成后去冰原外围找到阿嬉。

taskDesc2110403.en: Collect a Treasure to enable Xi to enter Everfrost- 1 {itemLink6371026}. Once you have it, go and find Xi on the edge of Everfrost. {itemLink6371026} can be found at auctions in Yun Mo.
taskDesc2110403.ch: 收集能让阿嬉进入永恒冰原的秘宝——{itemLink6371026}一块，收集完成后去冰原外围找到阿嬉。{itemLink6371026}会出现在云陌州的拍卖会上。

taskDesc2110404.en: Go in the direction indicated by the Iron Shard towards a place in the tundra.
taskDesc2110404.ch: 跟随铁尺的指引前往冰原中的某处地方。

taskDesc2110405.en:
Take gifts into Tushan for Tushan Yao to pay homage.

Foxes are interested in treasures that meet their cultivation requirements, as well as monster materials. They also like human ritual goods and works of art.
taskDesc2110405.ch:
给涂山谣带去进入涂山的觐见之礼。

据说狐族对符合其修炼需求的天材地宝、妖兽材料颇感兴趣，此外，他们尤其喜爱人类的礼乐器具、艺术佳品。

taskDesc2110406.en: Talk to the Nine Tails' Elder and find out why the Iron Shard pointed you in this direction.
taskDesc2110406.ch: 与九尾狐族长老对话，查探铁尺指引此处的缘由。

taskDesc2110407.en: Collect {itemLink6371036} and give it to Tushan Ru.
taskDesc2110407.ch: 收集{itemLink6371036}并将其带给涂山茹。

taskDesc2110408.en: Get a {itemLink6371046} from the Tao Nexus and give it to Tushan Ru.
taskDesc2110408.ch: 从道界机枢中获得一枚{itemLink6371046}并将其交给涂山茹。

taskDesc2110409.en: Defeat the Demonic Eagle and save Tushan Yao.

taskDesc2110410.en: Defeat the Demonic Eagle and save Tushan Yao.

taskDesc2110411.en: Return to Tushan with Tushan Yao.
taskDesc2110411.ch: 和涂山谣一起回到涂山。

taskDesc2110501.en: You Yuanzhi is trapped in the swamp of Hundred Thousand Hills. He needs urgent help.
taskDesc2110501.ch: 游远致正陷身十万大山怪潭边上，得赶紧前往救援。

taskDesc2110502.en: You Yuanzhi was hit by thunderbolt in Lei Ze and unable to move. Be quick to rescue.
taskDesc2110502.ch: 游远致在雷泽被霹雳击中，动弹不得，解救须快。

taskDesc2110503.en: You Yuanzhi is imprisoned at the pit bottom by villains. He needs help as soon as possible.
taskDesc2110503.ch: 游远致被恶徒投到井底囚禁，要尽快前往营救。

taskDesc2110504.en: You Yuanzhi would be frozen to death very soon in Everfrost. Need to be saved immediately.
taskDesc2110504.ch: 游远致在永恒冰原被玄冰冻住，冻死就在顷刻，要马上拯救。

taskDesc2110505.en: You Yuanzhi feels puzzled for his bizarre encounters and goes to explore for some clues.
taskDesc2110505.ch: 远致对自己的离奇遭遇感到疑惑，前去一探或能查到一些蛛丝马迹。

taskDesc2110506.en: You Yuanzhi has found something along his way. Check it out. You may find something.
taskDesc2110506.ch: 远致在途中发现了东西，前去一探或者有所收获。

taskDesc2110507.en: Since he kept a record before he died, You Yuanzhi must have found something. Check it out. You may find something.
taskDesc2110507.ch: 远致去世前仍将地点记录下来，一定有所发现，前往查看没准有所收获。

taskDesc2110508.en: The tavern owner said there was a man with a different ambition who was about to start a long journey. Maybe we could catch him up and get acquaintance.
taskDesc2110508.ch: 酒馆老板说附近有个志向不同一般的人正要远行，他还在附近，现在追上去也许还能看看究竟是何许人。

taskDesc2110509.en: The tavern owner said there was a man with a different ambition who was about to start a long journey. Maybe we could catch him up and get acquaintance.
taskDesc2110509.ch: 酒馆老板说附近有个志向不同一般的人正要远行，他还在附近，现在追上去也许还能看看究竟是何许人。

taskDesc2110510.en: The young drunkard's words are very weird. Follow up and ask what is the matter.
taskDesc2110510.ch: 酣醉青年所言十分古怪，或者应该跟上去细细询问究竟是怎么一回事？

taskDesc2110511.en: Jinghong is very worried about his master, so he leads us the way. If his master does have created a Three-legged Crow, the situation is really not to be overlooked.
taskDesc2110511.ch: 景弘十分担心师父玩火自焚，所以带路前往师父住处。如果其师真的造就一只三足乌，事态确实不可小觑。

taskDesc2110512.en: Jinghong broke up with his master to strive for the opportunity for me; just seize the time to go to the Fire Cave as he said.
taskDesc2110512.ch: 景弘不惜与师父割裂都要为我争取机会，抓紧时间前往景弘所说火窟为好。

taskDesc2110513.en: Mingtong has released the Firebird.I have to catch while it is still in the neighborhood.
taskDesc2110513.ch: 明通竟然放脱火鸟，现在火鸟逸去不远，要尽快追上设法制服。

taskDesc2110514.en: As expected, the firebird has caused so much destruction.I have to catch it. The bird must be restrained!
taskDesc2110514.ch: 果然所料不差，火鸟现在仍未上天已经造成偌大破坏，要追上逃逸的火鸟，不能任其自由！

taskDesc2110515.en: He was killed by the firebird because he wanted to revenge for his destroyed home. Have to find a way to catch it. I would not allow it to cause any more casualties!
taskDesc2110515.ch: 相信死者激于家园被毁所以找火鸟报复，结果遭到反杀。得设法追上肇事火鸟，不可让它再造成伤亡！

taskDesc2110516.en: Clearly, the firebird really hates human, so it is killing people everywhere. It is out of control. What shall we do...
taskDesc2110516.ch: 火鸟显然已经对人生出了戒心，所以四处杀伤人类。它已经失控了，要怎么办呢……

taskDesc2110517.en: Find out why is Magpie Zhehong staring at you
taskDesc2110517.ch: 看看折红鹊为什么要瞪着你

taskDesc2110518.en: Help Magpie Zhehong find the feather of Golden Crow.
taskDesc2110518.ch: 帮助折红鹊找到金乌尾羽。

taskDesc2110519.en: Give Magpie Zhehong the feather of Golden Crow.
taskDesc2110519.ch: 把金乌尾羽送给折红鹊。

taskDesc2110520.en: I heard that the Three-legged Crow had returned and defeated countless Cultivators. Maybe I should go to subdue the raging firebird in Yong Ning.
taskDesc2110520.ch: 听闻三足乌重现人间，无数修仙者已经败下阵来，或者我应该前往制服永宁州上空肆虐的火鸟。

taskDesc2110521.en: Leviathan's mistress, Bingyi appeared near Wei River. Go and check it out.
taskDesc2110521.ch: 何罗鱼的主人——冰夷出现在了渭水，且前去一探

taskDesc2110522.en: A powerful aura suddenly appears near Mu Xian's Wei River. Do you want to check it out?
taskDesc2110522.ch: 暮仙州的渭水突然出现一股强大的气场，其中必有缘故，且前去一探

taskDesc2110523.en: This scoundrel actually used the name of Osmanthus in his deception! He's not gone far! I can catch up to him and cut him off!
taskDesc2110523.ch: 这个可恶的家伙竟借双桂草之名，当面行骗！眼前此人逃去未远，还能追上将之截下！

taskDesc2110524.en: The strange Cultivator mentioned the monster leader. Could he have killed the great monster in the nest? Better find out.
taskDesc2110524.ch: 怪道人提来妖怪首级，莫非他的确已经杀死巢穴大妖？还是前往一探吧。

taskDesc2110525.en: This person took the money and ran. Let's catch up with him and get my money back before he's gone far away!
taskDesc2110525.ch: 此人收下钱财却拔腿而逃，乘他并未去远，赶紧追上追回钱财才是！

taskDesc2110526.en: This offender disciple has told you where the great monster is. It will be good to do him a favor.
taskDesc2110526.ch: 此名犯规弟子将那只大妖地方告诉你了，帮他一个忙亦未尝不可。

taskDesc2110527.en: The offender disciple tells you where the great monster is. It poses a problem for him, so the monster lying in wait must be not weak at all.
taskDesc2110527.ch: 此名犯规弟子将那只大妖所在地方告诉你了，让他如此棘手，想必在那边等待的妖怪一定不弱。

taskDesc2110528.en: These disciples are under your protection. The roads are dangerous in this world. Bring the disciples back to the sect as soon as possible. (Bring them to the main sect building)
taskDesc2110528.ch: 这些弟子已在你庇护之下，八荒世界，路途险恶，请尽速将门人带回宗门。（带到宗门主建筑）

taskDesc2110550.en: The Qin Yuan is plotting to take over the Sect energy spring. Even after being driven out , it still wanders the area around the Sect. Please confront the monster in battle and drive it from this place.
taskDesc2110550.ch: 钦原意图占据宗门灵池，虽遭到驱逐，但目前还徘徊宗门附近，请你击败钦原，将之赶走。

taskDesc2110551.en:
Yun Ya allows me to collect <r>Cosmos Essence</r> to replenish the Qi of the Greenscale Spring.
With this, in {#building1001Name1}, {#building1001Name2}, {#building1001Name3}, {#building1001Name4}, {#building1001Name5}, and {#building1001Name6} within the <g>{#areaName4}</g> region, there will be a opportunity to attack the <r>Mythical Beasts</r> that appear.
This is also possible in <g>Spiritlock Circle</g> within <g>{#areaName4}</g> <y>(So long as you have already completed the level once)</y> (You can ask about the location of the <g>Spiritlock Circle</g> at the Tavern). (Return to Greenscale Spring to submit)
taskDesc2110551.ch:
云涯让我收集<r>玄黄母气</r>补充青鳞池灵气。
此物可在<g>{#areaName4}</g>区域内的{#building1001Name1}、{#building1001Name2}、{#building1001Name3}、{#building1001Name4}、{#building1001Name5}、{#building1001Name6}内，击杀其中出现的<r>大妖兽</r>有概率获得。
亦可在<g>{#areaName4}</g>区域内的<g>残破锁灵阵</g>中获得<y>（非首次通关）</y>（<g>残破锁灵阵</g>的位置可以去酒馆中打听打听）。（返回青鳞池交任务）

taskDesc2110552.en: The Qin Yuan is terrorizing the people nearby the Sect. It will need to be driven out once again so this area can be safe.
taskDesc2110552.ch: 钦原宗门附近伤害百姓，为了宗门附近安宁，必须再次驱逐这只妖怪。

taskDesc2110553.en: You've twice driven away the monster, yet not only is it still here, it has also become even stronger. Yun Ya believes that the only way to be rid of it for good is to cut it down.
taskDesc2110553.ch: 经过你两番驱逐，钦原不但没有逃去，还变得更强，云涯认为只有痛下杀手，将钦原消灭。

taskDesc2110555.en: The monsters are not only disrupting people's lives here, but also trespassing on our sect territory. We must slay them all.
taskDesc2110555.ch: 妖物扰乱周边之余，还入侵我宗地盘需要，必须将其斩杀。

taskDesc2110556.en: These Bambukis are all escaping in the same direction. There seems to be someone commanding them. I should go after them to find out the mastermind.
taskDesc2110556.ch: 这些竹妖成群结队，都往一个地方逃去，像是有人在暗中指挥。不妨跟随过去看看究竟是什么人在捣鬼。

taskDesc2110557.en: Find Yun Ya at Sect Council Hall.
taskDesc2110557.ch: 回宗门议事大厅找云涯。

taskDesc2110558.en: This mystery man in black is very sneaky. It'd be better for you and Yun Ya to split up and track him in separate ways.
taskDesc2110558.ch: 这名神秘黑衣人十分古怪，与云涯兵分两路查一查这个神秘人为好。

taskDesc2110559.en: This mystery man must be up to something. Hurry back to the sect to discuss with Yun Ya.
taskDesc2110559.ch: 这个神秘人一定别有用心，速速回归宗门与云涯商量。

taskDesc2110560.en: Yun Ya thinks the mystery man is coveting the Emerald Dragon Scale, a lost treasure of the hamlet. We must hurry to the Dragon Saliva Gully, find the Dragon Scale, and save it from the mystery man.
taskDesc2110560.ch: 云涯猜测神秘人竟是觊觎山庄失传秘宝幻龙鳞，此时最重要的便是前往龙涎涧找到龙鳞保证其不被神秘人所得。

taskDesc2110561.en: Yun Ya has been spending a lot of time in the Manual Library after handling sect affairs every day. Why not pay him a visit and see if he needs help?
taskDesc2110561.ch: 云涯近日除去处理宗门事务之外，总在山庄藏经阁逗留，不如前往看望，看看他可有什么难处？

taskDesc2110562.en: Yun Ya seems to be worried about something. He's outside the hamlet gate. You should pay him a visit.
taskDesc2110562.ch: 云涯似乎正在为什么事情而烦恼，他目前就在山庄门户之外，不妨前去一探。

taskDesc2110601.en: Someone was looking for you... But something urgent led them to the monster base. Maybe you should go there too...
taskDesc2110601.ch: 有人似乎正在找你……不过却因为什么要事先行赶往了魔族营地，要不要去看看呢……

taskDesc2110602.en: Unfortunately, they are not here now. It is said they have left for Everfrost. Follow in that direction to see if you can catch up with them...
taskDesc2110602.ch: 很不巧，你所欲见之人并不在此处，但好消息是，你得知他们前往了永恒冰原，试试看能不能追上他们吧……

taskDesc2110603.en: Sage Tianxuan invites you to a chat in the Taoist Mind Pavilion. It's not some place every cultivator can visit. It must be a rare opportunity waiting for you.
taskDesc2110603.ch: 天玄真人邀请你前往道心阁一叙，此地绝非寻常修仙之人可入，想必是一番莫大机缘。

taskDesc2110604.en: Bitterfly Spirit invites you to a chat in the Mindsnap Temple. It's not some place every cultivator can visit. It must be a rare opportunity waiting for you.
taskDesc2110604.ch: 蝶怨仙子邀请你前往蚀心殿一叙，此地绝非寻常修仙之人可入，想必是一番莫大机缘。

taskDesc2110610.en: Read the Cavern Map from Jo.
taskDesc2110610.ch: 查看李四所赠的幽窟地理图地理图。

taskDesc2110611.en: According to Jo, the key to breaking through to Reborn Realm is to collect five Nether Seeds. Now that you have collected them all, you need to find a way to blend them.
taskDesc2110611.ch: 李四所说突破至羽化境的关键乃是收集五枚冥种，眼下冥种已足，需设法将之融合好进一步突破境界。

taskDesc2110612.en: On the map is marked an underground mine of Sun Flame. Go there to obtain it.
taskDesc2110612.ch: 地理图中记录了一处阳炎精金的地下矿藏，可以前往地底取得这些所需精金。

taskDesc2110620.en: Many Alliance Guards were wounded in the fierce battle, and we are in urgent need of Flame Begonias to treat them. Since they only grow on the steep cliffs or in deep caverns, we need capable hands to pick them for us.
taskDesc2110620.ch: 大量前线仙卫在激战中受伤，现急需“焰芯冰葵”支援伤者。此物或长于危崖绝壁或生于深穴幽窟，故托能人代为采摘。

taskDesc2110621.en: There are some cracks on the Alliance's city walls. The monsters may come back anytime. We are in urgent need of veteran cultivators to help us fortify the defensive spells on the wall by infusing their Energy into the array nodes near the Alliance.
taskDesc2110621.ch: 仙盟城部分位置出现裂痕。妖兽不知何时再次侵袭，现急需修为高深者前往仙盟附近各处阵法枢纽输入灵力巩固城墙禁咒。

taskDesc2110622.en: In ancient times, the first generation of Cultivator Alliance members came to Chi You. They left a lot of writings in the ancient caves. Please help us retrieve these ancient scrolls.
taskDesc2110622.ch: 远古之时，仙盟先辈到达赤幽州。他们昔日洞府之中还留下大量著述，请你帮忙将这些古老卷宗取回。

taskDesc2110623.en: Indica Rice is grown in a large area behind the Cultivator Alliance territory as foodstuff for the members to restore their Energy. Since it is a plant thriving on natural essence, we need high-achieving cultivators to nurture them with Qi.
taskDesc2110623.ch: 仙盟后方植有大片玉籼，专供盟中成员服食以补充灵力。玉籼聚天地精华，饱含灵气，故需修为高深的修仙者布散灵力滋养此物。

taskDesc2110624.en: Give the ancient scrolls from the mysterious caves to the Library Manager.
taskDesc2110624.ch: 将从神秘洞府中寻获的古老书简交还百城殿主事。

taskDesc2110625.en: The Alliance Wall has stopped the invasion of the Wave of Monsters, but some of them have sneaked behind our territory. We need experienced cultivators to kill them for us.
taskDesc2110625.ch: 仙盟城墙阻挡了妖兽入侵，但后方仍有零丁妖兽出没，现请经验丰富的修仙者前往将妖兽消灭。

taskDesc2110626.en: Xingtian's axe waving the other day bewildered one of our disciples. That Alliance Guard is very strong and wounded several other guards before escaping. We need a capable cultivator to defeat and bring back that guard.
taskDesc2110626.ch: 日前刑天挥动战斧竟导致仙盟弟子失控。这名仙卫十分厉害，逃离之际打伤数名仙卫，现特请实力不凡的高人将之击败并带回治疗。

taskDesc2110627.en: We've received a report of a strange Alliance Guard at the wall who is giving off Nether Air. It is a monster disguised as a guard. It has escaped behind our territory. We need someone to find it and kill it!
taskDesc2110627.ch: 近日发现城防仙卫形迹古怪，身周还散发冥气，这是一只伪装成仙卫的妖兽。目前妖兽逃离仙盟，藏匿后方，还请仙盟中人将它找出并击杀！

taskDesc2110628.en: Gusts of Nether Air have appeared out of nowhere near the Cultivator Alliance. It must be the breath of Mythical Beasts lurking behind us. We need capable hands to hunt them down.
taskDesc2110628.ch: 仙盟附近无故出现阵阵冥气，此必为大妖兽潜藏后方吐息所致。现急邀大能前往将之剿灭。

taskDesc2110629.en: We have received reports of monsters patrolling beyond the wall. We need capable hands to wipe out those scouts!
taskDesc2110629.ch: 近日城墙之外总有妖兽徘徊不去。此为妖族哨探，务必将之除去，故仙盟特邀大能外出铲除该类妖族哨探！

taskDesc2110630.en: Our Alliance Guards have detected some hidden caves beyond the wall using artifacts. These monster lairs must be destroyed immediately.
taskDesc2110630.ch: 近日仙卫凭借法宝，查得城墙之外若干隐穴。此为妖兽埋伏之处，需尽快肃清。

taskDesc2110631.en: Cultivator Alliance is going to set a powerful array for the imminent monster invasion. We need capable hands to help set spells in the array.
taskDesc2110631.ch: 针对即将来犯的兽潮，仙盟欲布置强大法阵歼灭妖兽。现请高人前往协助布置符咒。

taskDesc2110632.en: Some monsters seem to have intelligence comparable to us cultivators. Cultivator Alliance requests help from capable hands to capture some of those monsters for further study.
taskDesc2110632.ch: 某些妖兽似乎存在极高智慧，不下我等修仙者。仙盟对此等妖物进行详细探究，故请托高手协力捕捉。

taskDesc2110650.en: Mystery Man Jo is ahead absorbed in contemplation with hands clasped behind his back. Should you go up and greet him?
taskDesc2110650.ch: 前方神秘人李四正在抱手沉吟，要不要过去打个招呼呢？

taskDesc2110651.en: Explore the deep valley with Mystery Man Jo.
taskDesc2110651.ch: 与神秘人李四一起查探深谷。

taskDesc2110652.en: After your return from the deep valley, the woman's cry for help has been haunting your mind. Is there someone trapped there?
taskDesc2110652.ch: 自从去过深谷，你总是时时听到女子求救的声音，难道有什么人被困在那处了么？

taskDesc2110653.en: Tell Feng Yunchuo, Chief of the Demon about the odd voice.
taskDesc2110653.ch: 将听到古怪声音的事情告知魔族族长风允婼。

taskDesc2110654.en: After receiving Feng Pingmo’s message, Immortal Jo and Chief Feng sent an invitation. There must be more important things to discuss.
taskDesc2110654.ch: 收到风萍末书信之后，李四与风族长便即遣人邀请，想必有要事商量。

taskDesc2110655.en: After receiving Feng Pingmo’s message, Immortal Jo and Chief Feng sent an invitation. There must be more important things to discuss.
taskDesc2110655.ch: 收到风萍末书信之后，李四与风族长便即遣人邀请，想必有要事商量。

taskDesc2110657.en: Feng Pingmo finds the gap inside the Nether Mountains, and hurries to tell Immortal Jo the news so she can wait for rescue arrangements.
taskDesc2110657.ch: 风萍末发现冥山内部的开合缝隙，得赶紧将此消息告诉李四，以待下一步营救安排。

taskDesc2110658.en: Immortal Jo needs a Cold Flame to forge a sharp weapon to split open the Nether Mountains. He thinks this strange flame can be found at either the ice plains or the Hundred Thousand Hills. Chief Feng goes to the Hundred Thousand Hills to investigate, while you go to the ice plains to try to get the flame.
taskDesc2110658.ch: 李四铸造破开冥山的利器需要一股冷焰火，他以为这种奇特的火焰或在冰原与十万大山之中，风族长前往十万大山查探，而你则前往冰原设法取火。

taskDesc2110659.en: Bring the Cold Flame back, and tell Feng Yunchuo and Immortal Jo about Feng Pingmo’s recent situation.
taskDesc2110659.ch: 将冷焰带回，并将风萍末近况告知李四与风允婼。

taskDesc2110660.en: Feng Pingmo confesses the truth about what happened, and the present situation inside the Nether Mountains. She is so guilty that she deliberately sends messages to overload the Brocade Silk and burn it. You must hurry to inform Chief Feng of this message.
taskDesc2110660.ch: 风萍末坦白了当年以及现在冥山内部的真相，她十分内疚，故意传达讯息将宝绢烧毁，必须赶紧将这讯息告知风族长。

taskDesc2110661.en: Feng Yunchuo decides to rescue Feng Pingmo, and ask you to escort her back to the camp of the Demon.
taskDesc2110661.ch: 风允婼决定营救风萍末，然后由你护送她回魔族营地。

taskDesc2110662.en: Feng Pingmo and the Nether Beast burst out of imprisonment together, but she flees when she faces the Monster. Feng Yunchuo asks you to catch up to her and protect her.
taskDesc2110662.ch: 风萍末与冥兽一同破困而出，但她面对妖兽却落荒而逃，风允婼请你追上保护她。

taskDesc2110663.en: Feng Lixi is worried about her father and goes to the Nether Mountains despite the danger. She must be brought back.
taskDesc2110663.ch: 风里希担心父亲，竟然不顾危难前往冥山战场。必须将她追回。

taskDesc2110664.en: Since you are the only one who can contact the lost person, Chief Feng and Mystery Man Jo hope that you can lend a helping hand.
taskDesc2110664.ch: 由于现在只有你能和失陷之人联系，所以风族长与神秘人李四希望你能出手帮助。

taskDesc2110680.en:
Jo's map is somewhat blurred. You need to smear it with Holy Spring Stalactite to mend it.
<g>●</g>Gather it in <g>{#areaName8} and {#areaName9}</g> (requires learning its Prescription first).
<g>●</g>Alternatively, you can obtain <r>Holy Spring Stalactite</r> by killing monsters in <g>{#areaName8} and {#areaName9}</g> (learning its Prescription will increase its drop quantity).
taskDesc2110680.ch:
李四所赠地理图已无法看清上面内容，需要取得万年灵泉乳往图上涂抹才能将之还原。
<g>●</g>你可在<g>{#areaName8}、{#areaName9}</g>区域内采集获得（需要先学习药谱）
<g>●</g>可通过击杀<g>{#areaName8}、{#areaName9}</g>区域内的怪物获得（学习药谱后可增加掉落）获得<r>万年灵泉乳</r>。

taskDesc2110681.en: According to the Reborn Canon, you need to obtain Spiritual Item - Bamboo Heart in Illusory Bamboo Forest before locating the Nether Seed Cavern in Yong Ning with it.
taskDesc2110681.ch: 《羽化真诰》记载，需到幻虚竹海之中取得灵物竹空木心才能借此查得永宁州冥种幽窟的准确位置。

taskDesc2110683.en: According to the Reborn Canon, you need to obtain Spiritual Item - Tempting Soil in the Tempting Valley of Hundred Thousand Hills before locating the Nether Seed Cavern with it. On its side is a note written in red ink. It reads, "There are many monsters in the Valley, MANY monsters..."
taskDesc2110683.ch: 《羽化真诰》记载，要先到十万大山魅谷中取得灵物魅壤，才能以之查得冥种幽窟的确切位置。这段标注还有一行红字：魅谷之中有许多妖物，很多很多……

taskDesc2110684.en: According to the Reborn Canon, the Jade-cored Ice Palace floats above Mu Xian, and the Ice Angelica is grown inside it.
taskDesc2110684.ch: 《羽化真诰》记载，玉髓冰宫在暮仙州中西部空中漂浮不定。而冰芷在这座冰宫之中。

taskDesc2110685.en: According to the Reborn Canon, you need to obtain <r>Mercury Crystal</r> in Desolate Sandbar before locating the Nether Seed Cavern with it.
taskDesc2110685.ch: 《羽化真诰》记载，只要在洞天之地寂寞沙洲找到<r>汞源</r>，就能借此让冥种幽窟显形。

taskDesc2110686.en: You have obtained Bamboo Heart. The location of the Nether Seed Cavern in Yong Ning is felt.
taskDesc2110686.ch: 你取得竹空木心后，心中已感知到永宁州冥种幽窟的位置。

taskDesc2110687.en: You have obtained Wind Charm. You may now induce the heavenly thunders to reveal the Nether Seed Cavern.
taskDesc2110687.ch: 你取得风符后，引动九天之雷让冥种幽窟显形。

taskDesc2110688.en: You have obtained Tempting Soil. The location of the Nether Seed Cavern is felt.
taskDesc2110688.ch: 你取得魅壤后，已感知到冥种幽窟的确切位置。

taskDesc2110689.en: You have obtained Ice Angelica. A strange feeling emerges in your mind, and the location of the Nether Seed Cavern is felt.
taskDesc2110689.ch: 你取得冰芷后，心中生出异感，已察知冥种幽窟的确切位置。

taskDesc2110690.en: You have obtained Mercury Crystal. At the same time, you feel the location of the Nether Seed Cavern.
taskDesc2110690.ch: 你取得汞源后，同时感知到冥种幽窟的确切位置。

taskDesc2110691.en: The Array of Gathering Nether Feathers is formed. Now you could condense Nether Feather in it and achieve breakthrough to Reborn Realm!
taskDesc2110691.ch: 面前的五冥凝羽阵已经生成，可在上面凝练冥羽，让自己突破境界，达到羽化之境！

taskDesc2110692.en: Luoying, a senior in the Cultivator Alliance, seems to be bothered with something. Should you check her out?
taskDesc2110692.ch: 仙盟前辈骆瑛似在为什么事情烦恼，要不要过去呢？

taskDesc2110693.en: Go to the Tree Vault and check the mysterious tree. If possible, go nearer the tree to find more.
taskDesc2110693.ch: 去到建木附件查探神秘的建木大树，如果情况允许不妨进入一探究竟。

taskDesc2110694.en: Gu Yuan'er is trapped. There must be a mechanism here that controls the tree array. Find the switch to repel the entangling vines.
taskDesc2110694.ch: 顾鸢儿受困，此地必有控制树阵的关窍。要找出枢纽才能击退纠缠的藤蔓。

taskDesc2110695.en: Goumang doesn't want anyone to go to the Tree Vault. Go back to the Cultivator Alliance and report to Luoying.
taskDesc2110695.ch: 句芒似乎并不愿意有人前往建木打扰，回到仙盟告知骆瑛此事。

taskDesc2110696.en: Massive Nether Air has appeared in the distance beyond the city walls. Luoying summons you for a discussion.
taskDesc2110696.ch: 城墙之外的远方突然冒起大量冥气遮蔽天空，骆瑛希望你前往商量。

taskDesc2110697.en: There is a spurt of Nether Air in the uncharted area of Chi You beyond the city walls. The situation is dire. To protect the Cultivator Alliance, Luoying suggests a retreat. You are requested to organize the retreat from the old city walls.
taskDesc2110697.ch: 城墙之外的赤幽州未知地域冥气喷发，变得十分可怕，为保全仙盟实力，骆瑛建议暂时撤退，请你主持大事，撤离旧城墙。

taskDesc2110698.en: Check the wounded Luoying and learn about the situation of the lost alliance guards.
taskDesc2110698.ch: 查看受伤的骆瑛，并了解失落仙卫的情况。

taskDesc2110699.en: Luoying tells you the position of the alliance guards who are trapped deep inside the Nether Air. They are exposed to lethal danger. Rescue the guards as soon as possible.
taskDesc2110699.ch: 骆瑛将失陷在冥气深处的仙卫地点告知于你，待在那边的仙卫每时每刻都处在危险之中，要尽快将之救回。

taskDesc2110700.en: Goumang asks you to have a talk later
taskDesc2110700.ch: 句芒与你约定稍后与你作一次叙话

taskDesc2110701.en: You have rescued Alliance Disciples. Go back to the Cultivator Alliance and tell everyone the good news.
taskDesc2110701.ch: 仙盟弟子已经被解救，需尽快回到仙盟告知佳讯。

taskDesc2110702.en: The wood plaque has an unusual fragrance that only those in Mind Sea Realm can identify. Follow this lead to find the strange person who attacked you.
taskDesc2110702.ch: 木块留有只有通过进入识海境界后才能辨别的异香，或能循异香发现无故攻击你的怪异人影。

taskDesc2110703.en: All these happenings seem to be connected. Go to Tree Vault again to ask Bihong.
taskDesc2110703.ch: 一连窜事情似乎都有关连，不妨再去建木询问碧泓。

taskDesc2110704.en: Divine Mulberry Guardian sends you the branch and invites you to meet her. She and Goumang are always hesitant with their words. Perhaps you can find out their secrets this time.
taskDesc2110704.ch: 扶桑树守护者送来树枝邀你相聚；她与句芒总是欲言又止，或许此行能知悉他们的秘密。

taskDesc2110705.en: Bihong wants to use her Wood Nether Essence to let you go deep inside Chi You to challenge Xingtian. Bihong seems incapable of stopping Goumang, so she wants to help Goumang realize his hope.
taskDesc2110705.ch: 碧泓希望由她将木之冥源送出让你获得深入赤幽州深处挑战刑天的机会。碧泓似乎是无法阻止句芒，所以希望通过她自己来成全句芒。

taskDesc2110706.en: You have just finished talking with Bihong, and Goumang comes. What does he have to say?
taskDesc2110706.ch: 才与碧泓说完，句芒便出现了。他又有什么想说呢？

taskDesc2110707.en: In order to stop the spread of Nether Air, Goumang wants to fight against you with his remaining Wood Essence. Therefore, your potential could be activated, and you could confront Xingtian in spite of the Nether Air in the depth of Chi You.
taskDesc2110707.ch: 句芒为了阻止冥气扩散，情愿以残余的木灵与你一战，以激活你体内潜能，方能不惧赤幽州深处的冥气，才可与刑天一战。

taskDesc2110708.en: Nurtured by your Energy, the Nether Seed has grown ripe and agitated. You need to collect 10 Breath of Chaos to extract Qi close to Nether Air to tame the Nether Seed. The Breath of Chaos could be obtained by slaying monsters in <r>Lair of Desolation outside the wall of Chi You</r>.
taskDesc2110708.ch: 冥种受你体内灵力滋养，逐渐壮大成熟并表现得十分躁动。你需要收集10个混沌之息以提取里面与冥气相近的灵气以驯化冥种。混沌之息可通过击杀<r>赤幽州城墙外荒地兽巢</r>的妖兽获得。

taskDesc2110709.en: You introspect and find out the need of the Nether Air. This time you need to collect 5 Blessed Breath of Chaos to control the rogue Nether Seed. The Blessed Breath of Chaos could be obtained by slaying monsters in <r>Lair of Desolation outside the wall of Chi You</r>.
taskDesc2110709.ch: 你通过内观之法，察觉到冥气的需求。此次你需要收集5个上品混沌之息以控制作乱冥种。上品混沌之息可通过击杀<r>赤幽州城墙外荒地兽巢</r>的妖兽获得。

taskDesc2110710.en: The girl says Chi You is very dangerous and you should hurry to the Cultivator Alliance.
taskDesc2110710.ch: 少女称赤幽州充满危险，要尽快前往仙盟落脚。

taskDesc2110711.en: You met a girl called Gu Yuan'er. You decided to follow her guide to return to the Cultivator Alliance.
taskDesc2110711.ch: 初逢顾鸢儿，你打算先随她返回仙盟。

taskDesc2110712.en: Gu Yuan'er mentions a place worth seeing. You should follow her since this place is unfamiliar to you.
taskDesc2110712.ch: 顾鸢儿说有一个好去处希望与你同去，此处人生地不熟，不妨跟着这位姑娘四处看看。

taskDesc2110713.en: It's happy to meet an old friend in Chi You. Follow the guide of Gu Yuan'er and find Feng Yunchuo.
taskDesc2110713.ch: 能在赤幽州得知旧友，实在是令人高兴之时，便跟随顾鸢儿前去找风允婼。

taskDesc2110714.en: Feng Yunchuo has gone far away chasing the monster. Gu Yuan'er is very eager and wants to catch up with him to help kill the monster.
taskDesc2110714.ch: 风允婼追截妖兽已经去得很远了，你身边的顾鸢儿亦跃跃欲试，希望追上帮助风允婼击杀妖兽。

taskDesc2110715.en: Luo Ying sent you the news - perhaps there are emergencies to deal with. Return to Luo Ying immediately.
taskDesc2110715.ch: 骆瑛传来消息，似有急事相招，立刻回到骆瑛处。

taskDesc2110716.en: The Wave of Monsters may come in advance. Rescue the Alliance Guards currently performing their duty outside.
taskDesc2110716.ch: 兽潮有提前来袭之意，需前往救援还在外执行任务的仙卫。

taskDesc2110717.en: You have found the Guards. Bring them back to Luo Ying.
taskDesc2110717.ch: 成功救到仙卫，把他们带回骆瑛处。

taskDesc2110718.en: Luo Ying invited you to join the Cultivator Alliance. She hopes you consider the proposal carefully before giving any reply.
taskDesc2110718.ch: 骆瑛邀请你加入仙盟，希望你认真考虑后再去找她。

taskDesc2110719.en: You have destroyed the Heaven Sacrifice Altar and made a great contribution. The Alliance Master wants to see you. Go visit the Master.
taskDesc2110719.ch: 祈天台成功被毁，你立下大功，得盟主相招，请前往盟主处。

taskDesc2110720.en: The Wave of Monsters invaded. Take this chance to practice your skill by joining in the battle through the Monster Resisting Altar in the Cultivator Alliance.
taskDesc2110720.ch: 兽潮来袭，请厉兵秣马，在仙盟中通过御妖台参与一次兽潮。

taskDesc2110721.en: The energy in the Heaven Sacrifice Altar is about to exhaust. To prevent monsters from possessing it, you should follow Yuan'er and destroy it.
taskDesc2110721.ch: 祈天台能量将竭，为了不让其落于妖兽之手，你将跟随顾鸢儿前往祈天台将之销毁。

taskDesc2110722.en: Jiuying was heavily wounded during the battle against the Wave of Monsters. Take this chance and enter Jiuying's lair to kill the monster.
taskDesc2110722.ch: 兽潮一战，九婴重伤，可趁此机会前往九婴洞穴，寻找击杀机会。

taskDesc2110723.en: You did not find Jiuying in the lair, but you found a mirror-like Artifact unexpectedly. Perhaps Luo Ying knows something about it.
taskDesc2110723.ch: 虽未在九婴洞穴发现九婴，但意外得到一镜面法宝，不若带回去让骆瑛看看。

taskDesc2110724.en: Luo Ying said the Artifact is called Heavenly Insight. It can locate Jiuying once activated by infusing Nether Condensation into it. Now you should find the said Condensation.
taskDesc2110724.ch: 骆瑛认出此法宝为天目境，若灌输冥晶可激活此物，用来侦查九婴位置，现在需要前往寻找冥晶。

taskDesc2110725.en: After fighting, you obtained the Nether Condensation. Now return to Luo Ying and activate the Heavenly Insight.
taskDesc2110725.ch: 一番交战，你成功拿到冥晶，需回到骆瑛处激活天目。

taskDesc2110726.en: The Heavenly Insight is activated, and Jiuying's location is found. Go slay the monster.
taskDesc2110726.ch: 天目激活，发现九婴位置，前往击杀。

taskDesc2110727.en: The wood plaque dropped from the defeated enemy looks very strange. It can be a clue to the identity of the attacker.
taskDesc2110727.ch: 击败敌人后获得的木牌十分奇特；摸索查探此物或能得知袭击者的底细。

taskDesc2110728.en: Tao Tie is slain, but Jiuying has fled. You could only return to Luo Ying and tell her about the battle.
taskDesc2110728.ch: 饕餮被灭，九婴遁去，只能先返回骆瑛处告知详情。

taskDesc2110729.en: Luo Ying is trapped in a harsh battle against Xiang Lingjun, the Master of the Cultivator Alliance, in the mountain forest nearby. Find and rescue her.
taskDesc2110729.ch: 仙盟盟主向令钧正在不远处的山林和骆英大战，你需要前往解救。

taskDesc2110730.en: You defeated Xiang Lingjun and rescued Luo Ying. But unexpectedly, you find Jiuying around here. You decide to follow Jiuying for further investigation.
taskDesc2110730.ch: 你击败向令钧，成功救下骆瑛后，九婴竟然出现，你打算跟随九婴看看它想干嘛。

taskDesc2110731.en: You defeated Jiuying. With the help from Yuan’er, you also put Jiuying’s power under control. Return and inform Luo Ying.
taskDesc2110731.ch: 击败九婴后，在顾鸢儿的帮助下，你成功控制九婴，需要回骆瑛处告知结果。

taskDesc2110732.en: You decide to find {itemLink7000110} according to the location pointed out by Gu Yuan'er.
taskDesc2110732.ch: 你决定照着顾鸢儿所指的位置，寻找{itemLink7000110}。

taskDesc2110733.en: After a harsh battle, you get {itemLink7000110} at last. Return and hand it to Luo Ying.
taskDesc2110733.ch: 一番大战，你终于拿到了{itemLink7000110}，眼下将其拿交给骆英即可。

taskDesc2110734.en: Investigate the location given by the Mysterious Hint.
taskDesc2110734.ch: 根据神秘指引留下的位置，前去一探究竟。

taskDesc2110735.en: Luo Ying scolds Gu Yuan'er in public. Now Yuan’er is upset, perhaps you should give her some support.
taskDesc2110735.ch: 顾鸢儿被骆瑛当众教训后，情绪激动，前往安慰一番。

taskDesc2110736.en: The energy in the Heaven Sacrifice Altar is about to exhaust. In order to prevent monsters from possessing it, you should follow the guide of Yuan’er and destroy it.
taskDesc2110736.ch: 祈天台能量将竭，为了不让其落于妖兽之手，你将跟随顾鸢儿前往祈天台将之销毁。

taskDesc2110737.en: There is a monster of chaos guarding beside Jiuying. If you want to slay Jiuying, you should firstly kill Taotie.
taskDesc2110737.ch: 九婴一旁竟有混沌凶兽饕餮守护，若杀九婴，需先灭饕餮。

taskDesc2110800.en: Luo Ying was wounded when fighting the monsters. Ask about the savage monsters when you visit her.
taskDesc2110800.ch: 骆瑛与凶兽对战之际受了伤，凶兽似乎十分厉害，不妨前去探问之际打听一下凶兽来历。

taskDesc2110801.en: Luo Ying is worried that Gu Yuan'er left to hunt Jiuying. She wants me to bring her back. Sunny has told me Jiuying's approximate position. I hope Yuan'er didn't go to Jiuying's lair.
taskDesc2110801.ch: 骆瑛担心顾鸢儿此去乃是为了击杀九婴，她希望我马上将之追回。同时圣阳亦将九婴大概方位指出。但愿鸢儿没有前往九婴巢穴。

taskDesc2110802.en: The bronze mirror in the hut is very strange. Gu Yuan'er thinks it might be an artifact made by her father. Show it to Luo Ying, and she may know more about it.
taskDesc2110802.ch: 在小屋中发现的铜镜十分古怪，据顾鸢儿推测这是他父亲制作的法宝；请骆瑛看看，或能知悉中间隐秘。

taskDesc2110803.en: Elder Luo wants you to repair the mirror. The artifact is Elder Gu Nangang's work, and Yuan'er should have quite some knowledge of it. You should go ask her.
taskDesc2110803.ch: 骆长老希望由你设法还原镜子功用。法宝是顾南罡长老作品，鸢儿应该颇有心得，或者前去询问为是。

taskDesc2110804.en: Find Nether Air Condensation outside the town to see if it can reactivate the artifact.
taskDesc2110804.ch: 到城外寻找冥气结晶看看能否让法宝再次运作。

taskDesc2110805.en: The mirror is suddenly awakened and displays a purple-black dot. Since the mirror is capable of tracking the special monsters in Chi You, perhaps Jiuying is just nearby?
taskDesc2110805.ch: 镜子突然生出动静，并且标示出一个紫黑色的圆点。此镜能追踪赤幽州特殊妖兽，莫非九婴就在附近？

taskDesc2110806.en: According to this mysterious lady, there is a secret cavern a hundred leagues ahead. The Nether Air Condensation inside it should be able to reactivate the artifact.
taskDesc2110806.ch: 据这名神秘女子所言，前方百里外有一秘窟，从中可以起出冥气结晶，借此使法宝重生运作。

taskDesc2110807.en: The Heavenly Insight has marked the position of Jiuying. You should go right away to kill it to put an end to the Wave of Monsters.
taskDesc2110807.ch: 天目已将九婴位置标示出来，不妨即刻前往将之击杀，以解眼前兽潮棘手之局。

taskDesc2110808.en: After the victory against the Wave of Monsters, Alliance Master invites you for a gathering.
taskDesc2110808.ch: 小胜兽潮之战后，盟主邀请你前往一聚。

taskDesc2110809.en: You are not wounded. Luo Ying seems to be occupied, so she sent Gu Yuan'er to invite you.
taskDesc2110809.ch: 你身上并无伤势，骆瑛似乎另有急事，因此才让顾鸢儿特意来请。

taskDesc2110810.en: Elder Luo believes the Heavenly Insight has not fully recovered yet. She hopes you could continue to work with her to further repair the Heavenly Insight. Since Gu Yuan'er obtained Chi You Anecdotes, she has studied it well. You should ask her how to further repair the Heavenly Insight.
taskDesc2110810.ch: 骆长老认为天目仍未恢复昔日完美状态，她希望你继续与她合作，进一步还原天目。顾鸢儿获得《赤幽别志》，已颇有心得，不妨前往问问她如何进一步修复天目。

taskDesc2110811.en: Nether Air Condensation abounds beyond the Cultivator Alliance territory. You should search for it there to further repair the Heavenly Insight.
taskDesc2110811.ch: 仙盟外蕴含冥气结晶。要想进一步修复天目，还需到外查探。

taskDesc2110812.en: The Heavenly Insight displays the position of the Nether Air Monster again. Perhaps Monster Jiuying, who has troubled the Alliance for so long, is just over there?
taskDesc2110812.ch: 天目再次显示冥气妖兽的位置，难道困扰仙盟的妖兽九婴就在前方？

taskDesc2110813.en: Duanmu Yinglan agrees to go with you to fetch the Nether Air Condensation, and she asks you to help her find her lost friend in return.
taskDesc2110813.ch: 端木影阑答应带你前往取出冥晶，但相应地她亦希望你陪她走一趟，寻找她失踪的朋友。

taskDesc2110814.en: Duanmu Yinglan left in dismay, but she still told you the position of the Nether Air Condensation you want. It is to the east of your current location.
taskDesc2110814.ch: 端木影阑失魂落魄的离开了，她临走前将你需要的冥气结晶告知于你。地点就在你目前位置的东方。

taskDesc2110815.en: Give the Heavenly Insight to Gu Yuan'er, and she may be able to reactivate it.
taskDesc2110815.ch: 将天目交给顾鸢儿，她或能完全重启此物。

taskDesc2110817.en: Jiuying has learned of the location of her friend. Go with her.
taskDesc2110817.ch: 九婴已经知道他朋友的具体所在，这便与她走一趟吧。

taskDesc2110818.en: Alliance Master sends for you to help them defend the Alliance Wall and repel the Wave of Monsters.
taskDesc2110818.ch: 盟主遣人邀你一同守护仙盟城墙以对抗兽潮。

taskDesc2110819.en: The Wave of Monsters invaded, and the Master has joined in the battle himself. He orders you to stay at the Altar and prepare to fight when they are in need.
taskDesc2110819.ch: 兽潮来袭，盟主已亲身出战。他命你坐镇高台，随时准备出战。

taskDesc2110820.en: Alliance Master invites you to Wenji Mansion to discuss something.
taskDesc2110820.ch: 盟主请你前往问机别院商量事情。

taskDesc2110821.en: Alliance Master has made a plan to kill Jiuying. His subordinate invites you to meet him and wait for his orders.
taskDesc2110821.ch: 盟主设计击杀九婴，他的手下请你前往面见盟主，等候安排。

taskDesc2110822.en: Alliance Master wants you to go deep inside the Wave of Monsters to attract Jiuying's attention and disperse monster forces so that he will take the chance to encircle Jiuying.
taskDesc2110822.ch: 盟主希望你深入兽潮吸引九婴注意，让妖兽兵力分散。他则好借机围困九婴。

taskDesc2110823.en: There has been some infighting among the Cultivator Alliance for the post of the Alliance Master. Visit Luo Ying and learn more about it.
taskDesc2110823.ch: 仙盟因盟主之位悬空，内部开始出现争端。去跟骆瑛了解情况。

taskDesc2110824.en: Yuan'er wants you to persuade Luo Ying to become the new Alliance Master, but Luo Ying has other plans. Tell these to Yuan'er and ask her to stop worrying about it.
taskDesc2110824.ch: 鸢儿希望你去劝说骆瑛成为盟主，但骆瑛另有想法，将这些告诉鸢儿，让她别再着急了。

taskDesc2110825.en: Gu Yuan'er comes to you with a mysterious face. You told her about artifact Exorciser the other day. She might have found some clues about it.
taskDesc2110825.ch: 顾鸢儿神秘兮兮的找到你，日前跟她提及法宝辟魔，估计她已经找到了相关线索。

taskDesc2110826.en: Gu Yuan'er has figured out the approximate location of the artifact and drawn it on the paper. You should go there to look for it.
taskDesc2110826.ch: 顾鸢儿已经推知了法宝的大约位置，并将之图画纸上。前往一探，或有所得。

taskDesc2110827.en: Give artifact Sharp Awl to Luo Ying.

taskDesc2110828.en: Luo Ying insists that you should become the new Alliance Master. She is waiting for your reply in the Wenji Mansion.
taskDesc2110828.ch: 骆瑛坚持想请你就任盟主一职，她仍在问机别院等候你的佳音。

taskDesc2110829.en: After the victory against the Wave of Monsters, Alliance Master invites you for a gathering in the Wenshu Mansion.
taskDesc2110829.ch: 兽潮之战后，盟主邀请你前往问枢院一聚。

taskDesc2110830.en: You have obtained the Nether Air Condensation. Give it to Yuan'er and see if it can reactivate the artifact.
taskDesc2110830.ch: 你已取得冥气结晶，将之交给顾鸢儿，看看是否能再次让法宝发挥作用。

taskDesc2110831.en: Wave of Monsters is approaching. Use the Mirror of Heavenly Insight to locate Jiuying.
taskDesc2110831.ch: 当下兽潮来袭，使用法宝天目镜，查找九婴位置。

taskDesc2110832.en: Wave of Monsters is approaching, and the Master suggests you join the battle against the monsters. Please go to <r>Monster Resisting Altar in the Cultivator Alliance</r> to join the campaign.
taskDesc2110832.ch: 兽潮来袭仙盟，盟主提议你参与到抵御兽潮的战争去。请你前往<r>仙盟御妖台</r>加入此战。

taskDesc2110833.en: According to the Reborn Canon, you should use the <r>Wind Charm</r> to induce Lightning and to indicate the location of the hidden Cavern.
taskDesc2110833.ch: 据《真诰》记载，</r>使用<r>风符</r>招引天雷，才能使隐藏的冥种幽窟显形。

taskDesc2110834.en: You have known that the Ice Flower of the Everfrost is on top of the Jade-cored Ice Palace. Now you are near the palace, and you should enter it for the flower as soon as possible.
taskDesc2110834.ch: 侦察出永恒冰原的冰花在玉髓冰宫之上。此天上冰宫已在附近，赶紧设法进入取得冰花。

taskDesc2110850.en: Xingtian’s behavior is increasingly worrying these days. The threat is imminent, please challenge Xingtian as soon as possible.
taskDesc2110850.ch: 刑天近日出现不同寻常的动静，危机迫在眉睫。请你尽快挑战刑天。

taskDesc2110851.en: You fled from the attack of Xingtian, and when rescuing you, Luo Ying was hit by your opponent and fell somewhere in the distance. Come find and help her quickly.
taskDesc2110851.ch: 你不敌刑天，而骆瑛为了救你，被刑天击中，落在远处，需速速前往救援。

taskDesc2110852.en: Luo Ying is heavily wounded. It's not safe to leave her alone here, and you should bring her back for healing.
taskDesc2110852.ch: 骆瑛身受重伤，不能留在外面，需尽快带回去治愈。

taskDesc2110853.en: Chi You is on the verge of destruction. Xingtian must be slain.
taskDesc2110853.ch: 赤幽州危在旦夕，必须击杀刑天。

taskDesc2110854.en: You are defeated by Xingtian. Chat with other companions around you, perhaps they would cheer you up.
taskDesc2110854.ch: 你败给刑天，和周围的伙伴谈谈吧。或者他们能给你打气呢。

taskDesc2110856.en: Xingtian has been defeated, but your allies are heavily wounded. Now they are resting nearby, talk to them and find a plan for future moves.
taskDesc2110856.ch: 刑天已被击败，大家都身负重伤暂在附近休息，去和大家聊聊，看看下一步应该怎么走吧。

taskDesc2110880.en: Upon seeing you, Gu Yuan’er leaves the Cultivator Alliance hastily and goes to somewhere behind the Alliance’s territory for patrolling. It may be dangerous for a girl like her to fight against monsters. Should you assist her?
taskDesc2110880.ch: 顾鸢儿看见你后就匆忙离开仙盟去后方巡查，一个女子与妖兽搏斗，终究十分凶险，要不要去帮帮她呢？

taskDesc2110881.en: You’ve seen Gu Yuan’er returning to the Alliance safely. Come to see her at <r>the beginning of the next month</r>.
taskDesc2110881.ch: 你已目送顾鸢儿回归仙盟，<r>下个月初</r>再看看她吧。

taskDesc2110882.en: The Wave of Monsters will emerge <r>after 1 month</r>.
taskDesc2110882.ch: <r>一个月后</r>兽潮将会再度来袭。

taskDesc2110883.en: Gu Yuan'er thinks the Wave of Monsters will emerge <r>the next month</r>, and you could try the Artifact when they come.
taskDesc2110883.ch: 顾鸢儿认为兽潮<r>下个月</r>又将来袭，到时可以试用法宝。

taskDesc2110884.en: The Master thinks Jiuying will attack here <r>the next month</r>. He sees you as a potent warrior and is expecting you to fight against those monsters with the members.
taskDesc2110884.ch: 盟主认为<r>下个月</r>九婴就会来袭，他对你充满期待，希望你到时协助抵御兽潮。

taskDesc2110885.en: Gu Yuan’er intends to find the story of the awl from ancient books. She estimates the Exorciser’s story could be found <r>after 1 month</r>.
taskDesc2110885.ch: 顾鸢儿打算从古籍里寻找锥子的故事，她打算<r>一个月后</r>找出辟魔的故事。

taskDesc2110886.en: The Alliance has retaken the defense line before, and now everything is eventually settled. You should <r>go back to the Alliance</r> <r>2 months later</r> to discuss important matters with Luo Ying.
taskDesc2110886.ch: 仙盟回到旧日防线，诸事已逐步安定下来。<r>两个月后</r>便该<r>回仙盟</r>与骆瑛商量今后大事。

taskDesc2110887.en: Your communication with Goumang failed. Now you decide to wander in Chi You and wait for further information to form your next plan.
taskDesc2110887.ch: 当今与句芒沟通失败，暂且在赤幽州四处巡逻，看有何新消息，再做决定。

taskDesc2110888.en: Xingtian is going out of control, and something will surely happen in <r>the next 1 month</r>. With the help of Goumang, now you could try to enhance your power by <r>making a breakthrough into Transcendent</r>.
taskDesc2110888.ch: 刑天已逐渐失控，<r>未来一月</r>定有大事发生。而你得到句芒的帮助，已可尝试进一步<r>突破至登仙境</r>以增强实力。

taskDesc2110901.en:
The Cultivator Alliance needs help from the Demons in Yun Mo. However, those demons seem to be troubled by something. As a member of the Alliance, you should assist the demons to solve their problems and pave the way for them to come here and help us with important decisions.

Finish all Main Missions in "Suiren Kindles the First Flame".
taskDesc2110901.ch:
仙盟需要云陌州魔族的帮助，但魔族似乎正遭遇了一些危难，身为仙盟之人，理应帮助魔族脱困，使其前来帮助仙盟成就大事。

完成“钻木取火”全部主线任务。

taskDesc2110950.en: Gu Yuan'er is still inexperienced in fighting monsters. She needs your help.
taskDesc2110950.ch: 顾鸢儿实力不足以应付厉害妖兽，她需要你的帮助。

taskDesc2110951.en: Gu Yuan'er hands you the clue about the artifact Exorciser. Investigate <r>Sharp Awl Clue</r> to find the whereabouts of the Exorciser.
taskDesc2110951.ch: 顾鸢儿将有关法宝辟魔锥的线索交给你，查看<r>利锥线索</r>之后即可得知辟魔下落。

taskDesc2110952.en: Meet Jo at Youxiong Village, which is located at the foot of the mountain.
taskDesc2110952.ch: 前往山脚有熊村与李四一会

taskDesc2110953.en: Find the Kuafu Clan's divination cave and break its seal as Jo said.
taskDesc2110953.ch: 应李四所托，寻找夸父族人的洞穴遗址，并破解其封印。

taskDesc2110954.en: Find Jo at Youxiong Village and tell him you have broken the seal.
taskDesc2110954.ch: 回到有熊村告知李四，已为其破解遗址封印。

taskDesc2110955.en: Follow the secret path inside the cave and finish the task entrusted by Jo.
taskDesc2110955.ch: 前往洞中暗径查探，并履行李四之嘱托。

taskDesc2110956.en: You have told Jo your findings. Return to Tian Yuan Mountain and continue to climb to its top.
taskDesc2110956.ch: 李四之事已经解决，回到天元山中继续登上山顶。

taskDesc2110961.en: Night Rain forced a cultivator to swallow a poisonous elixir. Now the cultivator wants you to escort him to the cave where the demon woman lived to find the antidote.
taskDesc2110961.ch: 一名受到夜雨楼胁迫吞下毒丹的修仙者希望你能护送他去到女魔头的魔窟之中搜寻解药。

taskDesc2110963.en: Return to Tian Yuan Mountain to continue your journey.
taskDesc2110963.ch: 回到天元山中继续挑战。

taskDesc2110964.en: Night Rain wanted you to find a wooden hairpin for her from her past residence before you entered the Mountain.
taskDesc2110964.ch: 夜雨楼交代，让你在上山之前前往她的故居找到一支木簪并将之带给她。

taskDesc2110965.en: Night Rain hoped you to bring the hairpin to the Mountain's top and then give it to her after the Pavilion Master's plan has been fulfilled.
taskDesc2110965.ch: 夜雨楼留有嘱托，将簪子带到山巅，待帮助琅琊阁主底定大事后，再转交给她。

taskDesc2110966.en: Continue to climb up to Tian Yuan Mountain after you restored your health.
taskDesc2110966.ch: 养精蓄锐，继续登上天元山。

taskDesc2110971.en: Follow Nuwa's guidance to the place where you can learn about what happened to the future Zhang San.
taskDesc2110971.ch: 女娲给出地点，前往该处能了解到未来张三发生的事情。

taskDesc2110972.en: Follow Feng Yunchuo to enter You Huang Cave.
taskDesc2110972.ch: 跟随风允婼深入幽篁洞天。

taskDesc2110973.en: Return to Tian Yuan Mountain and wake Black Dragon guarding there.
taskDesc2110973.ch: 回到天元山中，唤醒镇守山中的苍龙。

taskDesc2110974.en: Go to You Huang Cave to learn the Thirteenth Verse, the key to waking Black Dragon in Tian Yuan Mountain.
taskDesc2110974.ch: 前往幽篁洞天参研第十三律借此唤醒天元山苍龙。

taskDesc2110981.en: To arrive at the top of Tian Yuan Mountain, you need to find out the key to the array there in the Dragon's Haven.
taskDesc2110981.ch: 前往龙眠屿寻找破解结界的方法，从而进入天元山巅。

taskDesc2110982.en: Find the reminder of friendship in Dragon's Haven.
taskDesc2110982.ch: 回到龙眠屿寻找纪念之物。

taskDesc2110983.en: The key to dissolving the seal has been found. Return to Tian Yuan Mountain and continue your journey to its top.
taskDesc2110983.ch: 你已学会解除封印的法门，回到天元山中，继续登山，前往山巅。

taskDesc2110990.en: Kill Skydevourer - Taotie and take its horn to make the Phoenix Talisman. (<r>Taotie's Horn is a possible drop from Skydevourer - Taotie in Chi You or Taotie in Chi You's Soul Devouring Pagoda. It can be obtained multiple times if needed</r>.)
taskDesc2110990.ch: 击杀吞天·饕餮并取其犄角以制作凤仙宝箓。（<r>赤幽州中之吞天·饕餮或赤幽州噬魂塔中的饕餮妖兽均有几率产出饕餮犄角，若有必要重新获取，可前往击杀取得此物</r>。）

taskDesc2110991.en: Use Taotie's Horn to make the Phoenix Talisman. (You may draw talismans in Artisanship - Talismans tab. <r>Taotie's Horn is a possible drop from Skydevourer - Taotie in Chi You or Taotie in Chi You's Soul Devouring Pagoda. It can be obtained multiple times if needed</r>.)
taskDesc2110991.ch: 利用饕餮犄角制作凤仙宝箓。（需前往技艺界面画符分项制作此物；<r>赤幽州中之吞天·饕餮或赤幽州噬魂塔中的饕餮妖兽均有几率产出饕餮犄角，若有必要重新获取，可前往击杀取得此物</r>。）

taskDesc2110992.en: Now you've got the Phoenix Talisman. Time to disperse the Nether Air in the junction of Earth's veins and fight against Hengtian, the Master of the Pavilion.
taskDesc2110992.ch: 仙箓已经齐备，前往地脉关元驱散冥气并进入挑战琅琊阁主衡天。

taskDesc2110993.en: Go to the junction of Earth's veins and see what's going on there.
taskDesc2110993.ch: 前往地脉关元进行查探。

taskDesc2110994.en: Follow Feng Yunchuo to enter You Huang Cave.
taskDesc2110994.ch: 跟随风允婼深入幽篁洞天。

taskDesc2110995.en: Investigate the strange waves of sound in the distance.

taskDesc2111200.en: Inspect the harsh battle you encountered.
taskDesc2111200.ch: 前去查看前方恶战情势。

taskDesc2111201.en: The mysterious alchemist, Yao Chenzun, has sent you an invitation letter. He hopes you to attend the exhibition held by the Divine Cauldron Temple, and he has provided you the road there.
taskDesc2111201.ch: 神秘人药辰尊发来请帖，书信之中，写明路径，请你前往参与神鼎观盛会。

taskDesc2111202.en: Yao Chenzun invites you to join the Divine Cauldron Temple. You could return to the Temple and inform him of your decision afterward.
taskDesc2111202.ch: 药辰尊邀你加盟神鼎观，只要你决定了，可以去到神鼎观找他。

taskDesc2111203.en: Yao Chenzun hopes Shi Qing can join them as well. He asks you to persuade her.
taskDesc2111203.ch: 药辰尊希望师青能归附他们，而你则担任说客前去说服师青。

taskDesc2111204.en: Tell Shi Qing's determination to Yao Chenzun.
taskDesc2111204.ch: 告知药辰尊师青的决心。

taskDesc2111205.en: Yao Chenzun's subordinate asks you to come to the branch of the Divine Cauldron Temple managed by Shi Qing.
taskDesc2111205.ch: 药辰尊遣人通知你前往师青管辖的神鼎观分观。

taskDesc2111206.en: You are poisoned by Yao Chenzun. Now you must return to the Divine Cauldron Temple to investigate the plot.
taskDesc2111206.ch: 药辰尊竟然对你下毒，此事还需回到神鼎观彻查明白。

taskDesc2111207.en: Tell Shi Qing about the horrible plan of Yao Chenzun at once and asks her to prevent the man.
taskDesc2111207.ch: 即刻找到师青告知药辰尊的恐怖计划，请她阻止此人。

taskDesc2111208.en: Shi Qing decides to foil the plot of Yao Chenzun. She invites you to the Divine Cauldron Temple after 2 months to defeat Yao Chenzun together.
taskDesc2111208.ch: 师青决定阻止药辰尊的恐怖计划，她邀你两个月后到神鼎观联手击败药辰尊。

taskDesc2111209.en: Tell Shi Qing about the horrible ambition of Yao Chenzun at once and asks her to prevent the man.
taskDesc2111209.ch: 即刻找到师青告知药辰尊的恐怖大计，请他阻止此人。

taskDesc2111210.en: Shi Qing decides to stop Yao Chenzun at all costs. She hopes you can come to her assistance then.
taskDesc2111210.ch: 师青决定倾全力阻止药辰尊，她希望你届时能前来相助。

taskDesc2111211.en: Yao Chenzun abducted Shi Qing, and the alchemists in her branch requested you to rescue their elder.
taskDesc2111211.ch: 药辰尊使计劫走师青，分观丹师请你协助救援他们的长老。

taskDesc2111212.en: Catastrophe fell upon the Divine Cauldron Temple again. But Shi Qing survived the disaster and reorganized the sect with other fellow alchemists in Mu Xian. She invites you to pay a visit.
taskDesc2111212.ch: 神鼎观再一次经历灭顶之灾，而师青侥幸存活，并带领炼丹师于暮仙州重建宗门，她诚邀你前去拜访。

taskDesc2111213.en: Explore the Master's Recluse Room mentioned by the two alchemists.
taskDesc2111213.ch: 前去探索途中两名炼丹师提及的祖师云房。

taskDesc2111214.en: Explore the ruined branch of the Divine Cauldron Temple in Mu Xian marked on the regional map.
taskDesc2111214.ch: 前往探索神鼎观分观地理图记载的于暮仙州的神鼎观分舵遗址。

taskDesc2111215.en: Explore the ruined branch of the Divine Cauldron Temple in Chi You marked on the regional map.
taskDesc2111215.ch: 前往探索神鼎观分观地理图记载的于赤幽州的神鼎观分舵遗址。

taskDesc2111216.en: Shi Qing invites you to the branch of the Divine Cauldron Temple managed by her to cure your Surging Yang Poison.
taskDesc2111216.ch: 师青邀请你前往她主持的神鼎观分舵以解除身上的阳亢之毒。

taskDesc2111217.en: Yao Chenzun is out for some managerial problems. He allows you to walk around and take casual looks.
taskDesc2111217.ch: 药辰尊外出处理事情之前请你在神鼎观周边附近游玩。

taskDesc2111218.en: Inspect the Recipe Collection given to you by the Elder of the Divine Cauldron Temple.
taskDesc2111218.ch: 查看神鼎观观主所赠的丹方辑录。

taskDesc2111219.en: Inspect the Invitation Letter given to you by the Elder of the Divine Cauldron Temple.
taskDesc2111219.ch: 查看神鼎观观主专程送来的请柬。

taskDesc2111300.en: Xi went to Everfrost again. Go there to find her.
taskDesc2111300.ch: 前往冰原查看再度进入险地的阿嬉。

taskDesc2111301.en: Xi was affected by the chilly air, and Snowgleam Flower would be a proper remedy. Monsters in the remote corners of Everfrost may carry the herb.
taskDesc2111301.ch: 于冰原深处击杀妖兽取得雪阳之花为阿嬉祛除体内寒气。

taskDesc2111302.en: Find the Ancient Soul Fragment in the Fallen Valley in Mu Xian.
taskDesc2111302.ch: 前往暮仙州陨幽谷取得太古残灵。

taskDesc2111303.en: Bring the Ancient Soul Fragment back to Xi in Everfrost.
taskDesc2111303.ch: 将远古残灵带回冰原，交给阿嬉。

taskDesc2111304.en: Inspect the soul that emerged from the Iron Shard of Xi.
taskDesc2111304.ch: 前往查看阿嬉铁尺上生成的魂灵。

taskDesc2111305.en: Travel with Xi and Yu to Hundred Thousand Hills.
taskDesc2111305.ch: 陪伴阿嬉和阿禹前往十万大山。

taskDesc2111306.en: Ask what would Yu do after that.
taskDesc2111306.ch: 询问阿禹的之后的打算。

taskDesc2111307.en: Travel with Xi and Yu to the remnant in the East Sea.
taskDesc2111307.ch: 带领阿禹和阿嬉前往东海遗址。

taskDesc2111308.en: Yu entered Hundred Thousand Hills and is inspecting everywhere happily. Follow Yu's steps.
taskDesc2111308.ch: 阿禹来到十万大山正四处查看，眼看是十分开心和兴奋。这便跟上阿禹吧。

taskDesc2111310.en: Escort Yu back to Tushan to meet someone there.
taskDesc2111310.ch: 协助阿禹回到涂山，寻访故人。

taskDesc2111311.en: Yu is talking to his old friend. Follow Yu and ask about his plan afterward.
taskDesc2111311.ch: 阿禹正和故人叙话，跟上去询问他之后的打算。

taskDesc2111312.en: Tell Xi the truth concealed by Yu.
taskDesc2111312.ch: 告知阿嬉阿禹隐瞒起来的真相。

taskDesc2111313.en: Bring Yu back to his home in Everfrost.

taskDesc2111314.en: Yu has decided something. Listen to him for his next plan.
taskDesc2111314.ch: 阿禹似乎已有了自己的决定了，去听听他接下来的决定吧。

taskDesc2111315.en: Enter the Blood Lord's lair and defeat him.
taskDesc2111315.ch: 前往血魔真身藏匿处，击败血魔。

taskDesc2111316.en: Yu suddenly collapsed to the ground. What's happened to him?
taskDesc2111316.ch: 前往查看突然不支倒地的阿禹。

taskDesc2111317.en: Yu sets his plan to live longer aside and wants to return to Bai Yuan at once. Talk to Yu about his decision.
taskDesc2111317.ch: 原本打算寻找方法活下去的阿禹临时决定马上回去白源，且看看阿禹如何吧？

taskDesc2111318.en: Bring Xi back from the Fallen Valley in Mu Xian.
taskDesc2111318.ch: 前往暮仙州陨幽谷带回阿嬉。

taskDesc2111319.en: Bring Xi to Bai Yuan to meet Yu for the last time.
taskDesc2111319.ch: 将阿嬉带回白源区见阿禹最后一面。

taskDesc2111320.en: Find the Frostsoul Gem in the Fallen Valley in Mu Xian.
taskDesc2111320.ch: 前往暮仙州陨幽谷中寻找拂霜石。

taskDesc2111321.en: Bring the Frostsoul Gem back to Bai Yuan as soon as possible.
taskDesc2111321.ch: 尽快将拂霜石带回白源区。

taskDesc2111322.en: Bring the Frostsoul Gem back to Bai Yuan as soon as possible.
taskDesc2111322.ch: 尽快将拂霜石带回白源区。

taskDesc2111323.en: Find out what is happening in Bai Yuan.
taskDesc2111323.ch: 前往白源区中一探究竟。

taskDesc2111324.en: Bring the Snowgleam Flower back to Xi.
taskDesc2111324.ch: 将取得的雪阳之花送回给阿嬉。

taskDesc2111325.en: You haven't seen Yu for some days. Maybe it's time to meet him again.
taskDesc2111325.ch: 别来数日，且与阿禹一聚。

taskDesc2111400.en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Yong Ning and find Enigmatic Stone.
taskDesc2111400.ch: 前往永宁州的地脉石窟取得界元石。

taskDesc2111410.en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Hua Feng and find Enigmatic Stone.
taskDesc2111410.ch: 前往华封州的地脉石窟取得界元石。

taskDesc2111420.en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Yun Mo and find Enigmatic Stone.
taskDesc2111420.ch: 前往云陌州的地脉石窟取得界元石。

taskDesc2111430.en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Mu Xian and find Enigmatic Stone.
taskDesc2111430.ch: 前往暮仙州的地脉石窟取得界元石。

taskDesc2111440.en: Eliminate the Nether Beast at the Pavilion Maid's request.

taskDesc2111441.en: The Nether Beast has been eliminated. Return to the Pavilion Maid to report your success.

taskDesc2111600.en: Explore the Supreme Forge indicated on the map.
taskDesc2111600.ch: 依照所得地图前往大冶台一探。

taskDesc2111800.en: Find out what happened following the creature.
taskDesc2111800.ch: 往青影去向之处探明虚实。

taskDesc2111810.en: Inspect the azure streak that flew through.
taskDesc2111810.ch: 前往查探空中掠过的青影。

taskDesc2111820.en: Inspect the azure streak that flew through.
taskDesc2111820.ch: 前往查探空中掠过的青影。

taskDesc2111830.en: The Fiery Unicorn is surrounded by cultivators. Find and rescue it.
taskDesc2111830.ch: 前往救援正遭修仙者围捕追杀的䑏疏。

taskDesc2111831.en: Find the gum and heal the Fiery Unicorn's wound.

taskDesc2111832.en: Find the gum and heal the Fiery Unicorn's wound.

taskDesc2111833.en: Inspect the Fiery Unicorn that is bound by the Immortal Rope.
taskDesc2111833.ch: 查看被缚仙索捆绑的妖兽䑏疏。

taskDesc2111834.en: Follow the azure steed to the treasure land.
taskDesc2111834.ch: 跟随青马前往埋宝之地。

taskDesc2112000.en: Before departing, Ao Yao promised to find a way to return after ten years. Will she be able to keep her word?
taskDesc2112000.ch: 敖瑶离开前与你约定，一定会在十年内后设法回归，她真的能做到吗？

taskDesc2112001.en: Assist the woman in finding manuals and return them to her.
taskDesc2112001.ch: 帮助女子寻找秘籍，并带回给她。

taskDesc2112002.en: Accompany Shuang Ling to find the manual
taskDesc2112002.ch: 与霜凌一起前往寻找秘籍
